Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays where the assay organism is human and the target is the Niemann-Pick C1 intracellular cholesterol transporter 1 (CHEMBL1293277). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293277'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
